data.gender_notes: Kaira is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kaira is recorded with the meaning “Mountain of Joy”. Kaira is a Sanskrit name meaning “Mountain of Joy”. in_sanskrit.name: कैरा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kaira is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaira', which means 'Mountain of Fortune'. This name is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and good fortune to the child.

in_hindi.name: कैरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Kaira in Hindi is the same as in Sanskrit. It holds the same meaning of 'Mountain of Fortune' and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune to the child.

in_tamil.name: கைரா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Kaira in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaira'. It is translated to mean 'Fortune' and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune to the child.

in_telugu.name: కైరా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Kaira in Telugu is also derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaira'. It is translated to mean 'Fortune' and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune to the child.

in_marathi.name: Kaira
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaira हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kailasa’, meaning mountain, and ‘Aarav’, meaning joy. In Hindu mythology, Kailasa is the celestial abode of Lord Shiva and Parvati. This name is believed to bring happiness and joy in one's life.

in_bengali.name: Kaira
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mountain of Joy
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kaira একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kailasa’, meaning mountain, and ‘Aarav’, meaning joy. In Hindu mythology, Kailasa is the celestial abode of Lord Shiva and Parvati. This name is believed to bring happiness and joy in one's life.
